# Marius Minia Developer

> Marius Minia is a web developer in Romania who builds business websites and helps teams solve problems in existing web projects.

## Services

- [Website development](https://marius93rm.github.io/#services): Responsive business websites with clear navigation, useful content, UX/UI and SEO foundations.
- [Development help](https://marius93rm.github.io/#services): Support for bugs, features and technical decisions in existing web projects.
- [UX/UI and software quality](https://marius93rm.github.io/#services): Figma, design systems, testing, TDD, refactoring and code review.

## Technology expertise

- [Technology experience](https://marius93rm.github.io/#teaching): React, JavaScript, Node.js, Laravel, PHP, C#, .NET, Java, Spring, Python, SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Angular, Vue.js, TypeScript, Storybook and Figma.

## Project fit

- [Ways to work together](https://marius93rm.github.io/#work): Launch a new business website, fix or extend an existing project, or make a technical decision with clearer context.

## Background

- [Technical background](https://marius93rm.github.io/#background): Computer Engineering studies at Sapienza University of Rome, the Apple Developer Academy and professional certifications.
